content.text: NC DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES

**ROY COOPER** • Governor
**MANDY COHEN, MD, MPH** • Secretary
**MICHAEL BECKETTS** • Assistant Secretary for Human Services

DEAR COUNTY DIRECTOR OF SOCIAL SERVICES
ATTENTION: Child Support Managers and Supervisors
SUBJECT: INFORMATION: Monthly Incentive Payments & Final FFY2016 Incentive Settlement
As of October 15, 2018, the October 2018 incentive payment for each county has been processed. Additionally, the final Incentive Settlement for FFY2016 has also been processed.
A copy of the spreadsheet is attached for your convenience.

Please note that incentive payments are disbursed to each County from October through June of each State Fiscal Year (SFY). The amount received for October is the amount your county will receive each month through June 2019, for a total of nine (9) monthly payments.
Should you have questions or need additional information, please contact Debbie Henderson at (919) 855-4455, or your Regional Program Representative.
